title: Evals triage & handoff - meeting prep + actions
body:
Context:
- Quick scratch for the 1:1 + weekly triage with Optimize/Evals reviewers. Goal: align on regressions, decide hotfix vs. rollback, and assign clear handoffs for prompt-set adjustments and A/B followups.
- Background: last nightly run (2025-07-20) showed a small but consistent regression on the docs-qa workload after the q4 quantized rollout. Degradation concentrated on long-context precision and hallucination rate.

High-level agenda (20–30m):
1) Quick status (2m): summary of metrics and severity.
2) Root-cause hypotheses (6–8m): kernel selection? quantization drift? prompt tokenization change?
3) Triage decisions (6–8m): rollback, config tweak, targeted prompt set update, or more data.
4) Action items & owners (4–6m): who does what, by when.
5) Quick sync on communications (2m): customer-facing notes and internal slack thread.

Key metrics to surface (paste into call):
- baseline EM@5 (docs-qa) before rollout: 78.9%
- post-rollout EM@5 (nightly 7/20): 74.1% (delta -4.8pp)
- hallucination flag rate (QA-critical): 1.2% -> 3.6%
- latency P50 change: +8ms (not critical)
- distribution: regressions concentrated at >2k token input length (tail of requests)

Immediate hypothesis checklist (fast scan during meeting):
- H1: int8 quantization edge-case for long kv-cache handling (likely, given token-length pattern).
- H2: prompt-template tokenization change (recent patch to shared prompts repo) causing bad token splits for code/doc examples.
- H3: kernel selection fallback used a different attention kernel at long seq lengths (recent runtime update).
- H4: dataset distribution shift in eval set (unlikely; eval set didn't change, but check ingestion).

Quick test candidates (to run in parallel after triage):
- T1: replay same eval with float16 (no quant) build to confirm quant-only regression. (owner: Morgan)
- T2: run subset of failing prompts with original tokensensitive prompt template (owner: Rhea)
- T3: enable alternate attention kernel flag on one node pool and rerun subset (owner: Noah)
- T4: run golden example regression check (5 hardest failing examples) with determinism on to inspect generation traces (owner: Ellis)

A/B result summary (what I observed in the round I ran this morning):
- Variant A: rolled quantized v1.9 (current prod) — nominal latency improvement but drop in precision on long docs.
- Variant B: de-quantized (float16) node — matched baseline quality on the 100-sample handcheck.
- Notes: A/B sample small (n=100) and skewed toward long-context documents. Need to expand to n=1k stratified by length.

Draft handoff recommendations (what I'd push if group concurs):
- Immediate: revert canary to float16 for long-context tier (rollback on canary pool) while we investigate (owner: SRE triage runbook, contact: Priya).
- Short-term fix: add tokenization sanity checks to prompt pipeline and add step to alert on token-splits > 1.5x median (owner: Rhea, due 2025-07-24).
- Investigate: run T1/T2/T3 tests in parallel and meet tomorrow with results (owner leads listed above, meet: 2025-07-22 10:00am PT).
- Longer-term: add length-stratified evals to CI so quant rollouts must pass >=95% of baseline per-length bucket (owner: Ellis + eng-evals roadmap).

Communications (internal + customer):
- Internal: create #optimize-evals thread with summary + pinned results and link to CI job; target: within 1 hour of decision. (owner: Ellis)
- Customer: draft short note if rollback affects any Dedicated customers with pinned models; hold until SRE confirms impact. (owner: Customer Success lead; I will draft text)

Open questions to resolve in meeting or immediate follow-ups:
- Does the quant build include any runtime micro-patches that reroute kernels at runtime? (Noah to confirm).
- Are there any recent PRs to shared prompts repo that touched tokenization logic? (Rhea will check and list PRs).
- Can we reproduce the hallucination spike deterministically on a single seed? If yes, we can diff logits. (Ellis to run determinism check)

Concrete action items (short checklist format):
- [ ] Morgan: run T1 (float16 replay) and upload results to the confluence page (due 2025-07-22 EOD).
- [ ] Rhea: run T2 (original prompt template handcheck), list PRs modifying prompt code since 2025-06-15 (due 2025-07-22 noon).
- [ ] Noah: enable alt-kernel flag on 2 nodes, run subset tests, collect perf/quality (due 2025-07-22 10am).
- [ ] Ellis: run deterministic 5-case hallucination trace, capture logits and top-10 token probs (due 2025-07-22 EOD).
- [ ] Priya (SRE): coordinate canary pool rollback if the group decides (standby 2025-07-21 afternoon).
- [ ] Ellis: post internal summary to #optimize-evals with links to artifacts (within 1 hour after call).

Notes to self (scratch):
- Keep meeting tight — focus on reproducible failures first. Resist scope creep into model-retraining discussion.
- If tests point to kernel issues, escalate to runtime team with clear failing example and deterministic seeds.
- Consider short-term guardrail: block quantized rollout for requests > 1.5k tokens until CI coverage exists.

Reference snippets (copy these into the call chat quickly):
- Failing example id: docs-qa-2025-07-15-EX-342 (present in confluence page).
- Quick diffs: baseline vs q1.9 at token 1,824 shows divergence at token-level beginnings of code fences.

If time during call: quick backlog grooming for evaluate-eval tasks that would be acceptable follow-ups (labeling effort estimate, infra time, eval creation).

End of notes.

Action: save this file as the working scratch for the call, I will update post-meeting with decisions and move to shared_drives if we reach final status.
